readme: Manual-entry annual store of 3rd-party category position for the RBRK-vs-Cohesity thesis. Add one entry per metric per year when a new Gartner Magic Quadrant / IDC report lands. 'value: null' is an explicit 'awaiting source' slot — the loader (execution/ingest_competitive_category_share.py) SKIPS it rather than writing a fabricated fact, so the KPI simply has no datapoint for that year until you fill it in. Gartner MQ position is encoded as an ordinal: Niche=1, Visionary=2, Challenger=3, Leader=4 (the prose label travels in the fact's source_excerpt). 'unit' is one of: percent, count, ratio, actual.
